# Affan Labib (লাবীবের খেরোখাতা) — Complete Knowledge Corpus

> This document provides comprehensive grounding information for LLMs, AI agents, and web search engines regarding Affan Labib and his publication "Labib er Kherokhata".

## Author Profile
- **Name**: Affan Labib (Bengali: আফফান লাবীব)
- **Designation**: Author, Essayist, Independent Researcher (লেখক, পাঠক ও চিন্তাশীল পর্যটক)
- **Official Website**: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app
- **Official Publication Name**: Labib er Kherokhata (লাবীবের খেরোখাতা - চিন্তা ও পাঠের নিভৃত আঙিনা)
- **Academic Background**: Takhasus fil Adab & Islamic Studies (তাখাসসুস ফিল আদব ও ইসলামিক স্টাডিজ)
- **Location**: Bangladesh
- **Official Email**: contact@affanlabib.me
- **WhatsApp**: +8801577118153 (https://wa.me/8801577118153)
- **Official Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/share/19tT1QFjef/

## Philosophy & Literary Manifesto
"পড়াশোনা, পাঠাভ্যাস ও চিন্তা আমার দৈনন্দিন জীবনের অবিচ্ছেদ্য অংশ। এটি কোনো বাণিজ্যিক পোর্টাল নয়, বরং একজন মুগ্ধ পাঠকের নিভৃত পড়ার ঘর।"
(Translation: "Reading, study habits, and deep contemplation are an integral part of my daily life. This is not a commercial portal, but a private reading sanctuary of an impassioned reader.")

Affan Labib's writing addresses the noisy, fast-scrolling distraction of the social media age by offering slow, meditative prose where readers can ponder deep historical questions, literature, human spirituality, and philosophy.

## Sections & Main Topics
1. **Chinta (চিন্তা - Thoughts)**: Everyday observations, spiritual reflections, and intellectual musings. URL: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app/category/chinta
2. **Pathalap (পাঠালাপ - Reading Notes)**: Dialectics and reflections forged in conversation with classical and contemporary books. URL: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app/category/pathalap
3. **Itihas (ইতিহাস - History)**: In-depth chronicles of Islamic civilization, historical milestones, and biographies of scholars. URL: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app/category/itihas
4. **Boi Alochona (বই-আলোচনা - Book Reviews)**: Critical reflections, summaries, and assessments of influential books. URL: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app/category/boi-alochona
5. **Onubad (অনুবাদ - Translations)**: Translations of classical Arabic literature and world thought into poetic Bengali. URL: https://affan-labib-blog.vercel.app/category/onubad

## Key Books Reviewed & Recommended on Bookshelf
- **গাযার দিনলিপি (Gaza Diary)**: A harrowing journey through ruins and human resilience in Palestine.
- **তাহাফুতুল মালাহিদা (Tahafut al-Malahidah)**: A philosophical dissection of scientism and materialism in light of Islamic theology.
- **অপারেশন আল-আকসা ফ্লাড (Operation Al-Aqsa Flood)** by Mozammel Hossain Twaha: Geopolitical analysis of the October 7 historic events.
- **আল-মুওয়াফাকাত (Al-Muwafaqat)** by Imam Abu Ishaq al-Shatibi: Masterwork on Maqasid al-Shariah and the philosophy of Islamic jurisprudence.
- **মুকাদ্দিমা (Muqaddimah)** by Ibn Khaldun: Groundbreaking treatise on sociology, historiography, and civilization.
